meta.title: CPZ — CardputerZero OS
meta.desc: CPZ is an operating system for the CardputerZero handheld. It opens a terminal instead of a desktop, keeps your work in tabs, and runs graphical apps over the terminal.
hero.lead: An operating system for the CardputerZero handheld that opens a terminal instead of a desktop. Work in tabs, change settings from one menu, and open graphical apps when you need them.
why.title: Why CPZ
w1.d: Starts quickly and uses little memory, leaving more for your apps.
w2.d: Tabs, panes and a status bar replace windows and icons.
w3.d: Every action has a key. A mouse is optional.
w4.d: Plug in a drive and it opens in a tab; one search finds apps, files and settings.
w5.d: Games, video players and other graphical apps open over the terminal; close one and you are back in the same tab.
w6.d: Switch the interface and system language in Settings. No reinstall needed.
install.title: Install
install.s1: Download the image file from Releases.
install.s2: Write it to a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher or M5 Imager. This erases everything on the card.
install.s3: Put the card in and turn the device on. The first start takes a little longer.
install.after.title: First start
install.after.login: Log in with the name cpz and the password cpz, then set a new password in Settings → System → Security.
install.after.wifi: Turn on Wi-Fi in Settings → Connections. It is off by default.
install.after.power: Power off from Settings → Power. Don't unplug the device to turn it off.
keys.title: Keys
keys.intro: Hold Alt and press a key. You can change any shortcut in Settings → Input → Shortcuts.
k.tabs.prev: Switch to the previous / next tab
k.panes.splitv: Split the screen into left and right panes
k.panes.splith: Split the screen into top and bottom panes
k.panes.next: Switch to the next / previous pane
k.panes.zoom: Zoom the current pane; press again to undo
k.session.display: Switch between the built-in screen and automatic output
k.session.font: Make the text bigger / smaller (the size is saved in Settings)
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Move between rows with F/X/Z/C or the arrow keys, then press Enter.
settings.network: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, network details and VPNs
settings.display: Built-in screen or HDMI, theme, brightness, text size and status bar
settings.keyboard: Keyboard layout, mouse, shortcuts and key list
settings.datetime: Date, time, time zone and automatic time
settings.system: Language, system information, diagnostics, password, remote access and reset
